content.title: Tesla stock pops on Musk post, Alibaba, Baidu, & BYD in focus

Tesla (TSLA) stock gains after Elon Musk said the company's Robotaxi fleet will double.

The Pentagon suggested Alibaba (BABA), Baidu (BIDU), and BYD (BYDDY) should be added to a list of those believed to be helping the Chinese military, according to a report from Bloomberg.
